purpose: Canonical Bangladesh division/district/upazila identifiers. District and upazila names and geocodes are read from the pinned BARC crop-suitability API captures; this file adds only the division prefix table and spelling aliases.

source.publisher: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council (BARC) crop-zoning suitability API
source.code_scheme: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) geocodes: a district code is its 2-digit division code followed by the 2-digit district code; an upazila code appends a 2-digit upazila code to its district code.
source.coverage_note: BARC lists 64 districts and 482 upazilas. A farm in an upazila BARC does not list keeps its typed name but has no upazila geocode.
